## Verification Checklist

Please verify each of the following before requesting a review:

- [ ] **Client-Side Guarantee:** No plaintext passwords, hashes, or sensitive data are stored or leaked to unauthorized third parties.
- [ ] **Content Security Policy (CSP):** Verified that no CSP violations occur in the browser console.
- [ ] **Design Language:** Adheres to the paper-and-ink aesthetic (no gradients, neon shadows, or unsolicited popups; maintains proper typography & contrast).
- [ ] **Cross-Browser Verification:** Tested in at least two modern desktop browsers (e.g. Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and responsive mobile views.
- [ ] **No Console Errors:** Browser developer tools console is clean of errors or unexpected warnings.
- [ ] **Documentation:** Updated `README.md` or technical reference if behavior or options changed.
